title: kith-tui has no input timeout for SSE or JMAP calls
description: client.rs call_jmap and run_sse use reqwest without an explicit timeout. A kithd that accepts the connection but never sends a response will cause the TUI to hang indefinitely in an await. The 50ms tick interval only fires when a tokio::select! branch completes; a pending HTTP call blocks that branch. The SSE task is a separate spawned task so it would hang there, but call_jmap is awaited directly from the event loop in handle_state_change and load_startup_data. Trigger: kithd goes into a long GC pause or network partition after TLS handshake; TUI becomes unresponsive to keyboard events.
